entry.title: UBCIT eSAM Servers Maintenance September 24, 2026, 20:00-23:00 PT
entry.content:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Sep 24, 20:00 - 23:00 PDT

Sep 9, 10:44 PDT
Scheduled - UBCIT will be performing maintenance on the eSAM component and vault servers on September 24, 2026, 20:00-23:00 PT. This change will affect both UBC campuses.

Users will intermittently not be able to login to any servers managed by eSAM, nor retrieve any credentials via the eSAM Web UI throughout the maintenance window.

Any connections terminated while a component is being rebooted can be reconnected to the secondary node. All connections will be terminated and users won't be able to reconnect while we patch the vault servers (which typically lasts around 30 minutes) during this window.

entry.title: View My Teaching Schedule report in Workday not showing teaching assignments
entry.content:
Sep 21, 16:17 PDT
Investigating - Faculty are unable to view their current or upcoming teaching assignments when using the View My Teaching Schedule report in Workday. The issue is being investigated.

In the meantime, when running the View My Teaching Schedule report in Workday to view teaching assignments, search for the specific academic period in the 'Academic Period' field. For example, for 2026 Winter Term 1, type in "2026 Winter" and press 'Enter'. Select from the academic period options. Select 'OK'.

Please reach out to the Integrated Service Centre for questions and support.
